'''Baradium thermal charges''' were a type of explosive used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errrant'']]</ref> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] utilized the charges while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]].<ref name="Errant" />
